name: comp-206
title: Select With Helper Text
blurb: Select with helper text below explaining the field.
description: Select with Label, SelectTrigger, SelectContent, and helper text below using aria-live and role='region' for screen reader announcements.
use_when: You need to provide context or guidance about the select choice.
avoid_when: For simple selects where purpose is obvious.
a11y: Label linked via htmlFor. Helper text is live region for screen readers. Full keyboard navigation.
